skills.description: Grant shields to allies. When the shield duration expires, put allies whose shield remains intact in a state of Berserk and clear any debuffs on them; inflict vulnerability on allies whose shield is lost.

skills.name: Assault
skills.description: After a warning signal, deal high damage to enemy units in a row or column and clear buffs on them continuously.

skills.name: Berserk
skills.description: Greatly increase attack speed.

skills.name: Fortitude
skills.description: Limit the amount of damage taken from a single instance of damage.

182001.introduce: A Sangvis specialized in gathering and analyzing intelligence. She isn't the best in direct confrontations, which earns her little respect among Sangvis Dolls. Rational, curt, and dutiful, she despises sentimentality and looks down on emotional Griffin Dolls who blindly follow their orders.
182001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Scarecrow
skills.description: Scarecrow rotates her three floating guns and does 3 instances of damage to the targeted unit.

183001.introduce: Mostly in charge of issuing commands and deploying units. Relatively high in rank, she is in command of combat units, yet is quite adept at combat herself. Answers directly to Agent. Serious, uptight, and meticulous, she always appears cool and businesslike both in speech and action. She holds herself to a code of honor even against her enemies.
183001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Gager
skills.description: Gager does 4 instances of damage to her target with a single attack.

skills.name: Gager's Quantum Sting
skills.description: A skill used by Gager after being outfitted with higher-spec combat modules. She marks an area and then deals damage to all units within it. After locking onto a row, she deals two instances of armor-ignoring damage.

skills.name: Tactical Update - Gager
skills.description: Now that she is no longer under Elisa's control, she has found her own way of fighting. Every hit charges up energy for her weapon. When her charge is full, she can switch to melee mode for a while. Damage dealt in melee mode cannot miss and scales with Dummy-Links, and her armor penetration capabilities are greatly increased.

184001.introduce: A loner with high combat prowess that specializes in long-range attacks and fire support. A cheerful and energetic airhead of a girl who's always in high spirits. She isn't particularly antagonistic towards Griffin and doesn't always go out of her way to follow orders from Sangvis Ferri. However, her passion for bombardment and destruction still makes her a highly dangerous enemy.
184001.counter: This enemy deals high damage to flagged positions and splash damage to nearby units. Make sure you move your T-Dolls in time to evade her attacks.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics: Architect
skills.description: Randomly launches grenades on friendly tiles, dealing unavoidable damage to all dummy-links.

skills.name: Architect's Missile Launch
skills.description: A skill used by Architect after being outfitted with higher-spec combat modules. Randomly locks onto a enemy unit, then attacks the target with unavoidable damage in a cross-shaped AOE.

185001.introduce: In charge of liaising between Elisa and her Sangvis subordinates as well as logistics management. As a high-ranking unit adept at both combat and tactics, she's able to command all Dolls in combat, and they all directly answer to her. Calm and composed, she always speaks in a courteous tone to friends and foes alike. However, apart from the genuine respect she has for her master, she holds everyone else in low regard, especially Griffin.
185001.counter: When this unit activates her shield, penetrate it by concentrating your fire to stop her high-damage attack from charging.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Agent
skills.description: Summon Dummy Agents, which can attack but have reduced damage. The Dummies have armor and can withstand small amounts of damage.

skills.name: Key of Omens
skills.description: Agent stops attacking and deploys a shield that absorbs damage. If the shield is not broken within 8 seconds, Agent drops the shield and unleashes a devastating attack, destroying all enemy units.

186001.introduce: An elite scout who often partners with Scarecrow but is slightly higher in rank. A rough-mannered and impulsive tomboy who takes delight in fair fights and dislikes bullying the weak.
186001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Executioner
skills.description: Executioner locks onto the unit closest to herself and uses her sword to cleave through up to 2 enemy units, dealing high damage that ignores armor.

187001.introduce: An expert in blowing things up and disarming bombs who also possesses decent combat abilities. Occasionally teams up with Alchemist. She's usually haughty and sharp-tongued, but is actually a tsundere with a somewhat childish temper. She cries under pressure and is very sensitive about her height.
187001.counter: This unit deals incredibly high single-target damage but has a low rate of fire and mediocre accuracy. T-Dolls with high evasion provide better defense against her.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Destroyer
skills.description: Destroyer fires grenades into the air. The grenades fall in a straight line along the flagged locations, dealing damage to all enemy units on them.

skills.name: Tactical Update - Destroyer
skills.description: Now that she is no longer under Elisa's control, she has found her own way of fighting. After every 10 regular attacks, she fires a grenade that cannot miss at the enemy with the highest HP, dealing 2x damage.

188001.introduce: An intelligent Doll created after the Butterfly Incident with high combat capabilities, specializing in short-range assaults and defensive battles. But as the test subject in the developmental phase, her AI is very unstable and difficult to control. Possessing an overwhelming tactical and intellectual advantage over others, she is very self-assured and conceited, but she has little actual combat experience and is too unpredictable even for her allies, which makes her highly dangerous.
188001.counter: This unit deals high damage to flagged positions. Be sure to move your Dolls away in time to evade her attack.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Ouroboros
skills.description: Open the rear ends of her round floating cannons, then fire four guided missiles at the flagged locations, doing a total of 2x damage to characters on those tiles.

skills.name: Tactical Update - Ouroboros
skills.description: Under certain conditions, she faces her enemies with heightened focus. Each critical hit she inflicts reduces her target's damage and rate of fire by 50%. She can also summon hover cannons to support her in combat, while using her outstanding computational capabilities to boost all her allies' rate of fire and crit rate.

189001.introduce: Combat-oriented and possesses ultra long-range pinpoint sniping capability. A Doll created after the Buttlerfly Incident who answers directly to Elisa. Since she isn't designed to engage enemies directly, she spends most of her time hanging around Sangvis Ferri HQ and bullying Judge for her own amusement. Her charming smile is a flimsy disguise for her arrogance and capriciousness. She is extremely mentally unstable and egotistical, and is prone to becoming frenzied and losing control in battle. She has formidable destructive power and will often disregard her allies' safety. Fortunately, she rarely ever appears in direct combat.
189001.counter: This unit can fire from long range. Take your units' moving speed into consideration to prevent heavy losses suffered from spending too much time in motion.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Dreamer
skills.description: After displaying a warning marker, fires a beam that pierces an entire row, dealing armor-ignoring damage that automatically hits all enemies in its path.

skills.name: Tactical Update - Dreamer
skills.description: Now that she is no longer under Elisa's control, she has found her own way of fighting. She gains stacks of Aggression at certain intervals, and when she reaches max stacks she goes into Burst Mode, which increases her damage and rate of fire by 100%. However, she also gains 100% vulnerability.

190001.introduce: Mobile and intelligent, she's skilled at harassment and pursuit battles. Her true power can only be shown when coordinating with Scarecrow and Executioner. She is calm and subdued, and cornering her foes through various means before capturing them alive. While she has an arrogant attitude toward Griffin, it does not preclude her from using overly despicable methods against them.
190001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Hunter
skills.description: Hunter rapidly fires her handguns for a brief duration, dealing many instances of high damage to her target.

191001.introduce: A Sangvis elite who specializes in all kinds of tactics and interrogations. Occasionally teams up with Destroyer. Arrogant, brash, and ruthless, she will do anything to achieve her goals. She has a sadistic streak and toys with Griffin Dolls to satisfy her perverse tendencies. However, her mental maturity still compels her to go the extra mile for her Sangvis companions.
191001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Alchemist
skills.description: Alchemist jumps and moves rapidly, dealing multiple instances of damage to her target.

192001.introduce: In charge of providing battle strategies, yet also adept at decryption and sabotage. Relatively high in rank, she can directly issue commands to combat Dolls but answers to Gager. Her apparent poise and soft-spokenness mask a gaping sense of emptiness. She enjoys human theater and hopes to derive her own personality from it.
192001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Intruder
skills.description: Use a machine gun to inflict multiple instances of damage on her target for a short while.

193001.introduce: Command-oriented and responsible for Sangvis Ferri HQ's defense and security systems. She is essentially Elisa's bodyguard and only obeys Elisa's personal orders. A Doll created after the Butterfly Incident. Having to deal with Dreamer's antics every day gives her a headache. Stern and old-fashioned, she possesses a soldier's dignity and bearing. She is absolutely loyal to Elisa, but her short stature doesn't make her very imposing to most people. Anyone who points that out will suffer terribly, friend or foe.
193001.counter: This unit has a high rate of fire and attacks multiple targets simultaneously, but only deals moderate damage. Shotgun Dolls are recommended to provide adequate armor. Be sure to move out of purple areas in time to avoid taking continuous damage and getting debuffed.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Judge - Trial
skills.description: Judge deploys a purple shield in front of her, granting her extra armor while it is up.

skills.name: Sangvis Tactics - Judge - Sentence
skills.description: Judge cancels her defensive status and glows with purple light. In this state, Judge gains extra firepower.

skills.name: Plague Field
skills.description: Judge jumps up and launches a flying kick at a random enemy Doll, leaving a purple mark on the spot where she touches down. Units which remain in this purple area suffer reduced firepower.

194001.introduce: Scarecrow - Demonic Abyss is a new model with enhanced firepower. With new upgrades, Scarecrow's hovering guns are capable of more powerful damage output. The command ports on her fingertips are also enhanced, strengthening the connection between Scarecrow and the hovering guns. The inspiration for her outfit is apparently a certain mythical beast that would wreak havoc in human villages at the end of each year. Its ferocious eyes would glow in the dark, and its sharp claws can tear through anything... just like Scarecrow.

skills.name: Sangvis Strategy - Demonic Abyss
skills.description: The three guns around Scarecrow rotate and fire at the same time, dealing 3 instances of damage to her target which has a chance of inflicting a random debuff.

200001.introduce: A combat unit mainframe built in the form of a spider with high mobility. It is equipped with a large complement of smaller combat droids, which makes it a formidable opponent in both assaults and surprise encounters.
200001.counter: This unit with strong armor spawns clones to disrupt its enemies. It also has considerable defensive capability, so be sure to engage with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

skills.name: Silk Spinning
skills.description: Lock on to a target and reduce their rate of fire and movement speed.

skills.name: Reproduction
skills.description: Spawn multiple small clones as reinforcements.

skills.name: Slash
skills.description: Switch to melee mode and increase attack damage.

201001.introduce: A small combat unit built in the form of a spider with extremely high mobility and offensive capability. It does devastating damage to both living and mechanical units. These units are spawned in large, unpredictable swarms, making them formidable enemies.
201001.counter: This unit has relatively high evasion and will close in on your echelon rapidly. Eliminate this unit early on in battle.

skills.name: Venom
skills.description: Each attack reduces the target's damage output.

202001.introduce: A fortress-type ultra-heavy combat droid that can transport land forces. It also possesses strategic-level battlefield attack capabilities, making it an advanced combat unit that can easily tip the scales in battles.
202001.counter: In addition to having powerful defensive capability, this unit is also capable of making decent AoE attacks. It is recommended that you prioritize eliminating this unit.

skills.name: Clean-Up
skills.description: Perform a two-instance spray attack across the row of a random target.

skills.name: Bombardment
skills.description: Lock on to the target with the lowest HP and bombard the square that they are standing on.

skills.name: Fortress
skills.description: Damage taken by surrounding units is greatly reduced.

203001.introduce: An engineer-type combat droid. It is not particularly lethal or destructive on its own, but as a support unit for other enemies, it can cause quite the headache. Its drone is constantly monitoring the battlefield from above.
203001.counter: This unit will keep spawning drones to gain an advantage in combat. Do not let the battle drag on for too long.

skills.name: Drone
skills.description: Create drones as reinforcements.

skills.name: Mechanical Maintenance
skills.description: Grant mechanical units a shield.

204001.introduce: Paradeus' newest ultra-heavy mech unit. It is capable of doing devastating damage from long, mid, and short range, making it an all-rounder in combat and a dreadful opponent.
204001.counter: This armored unit is extremely versatile in combat. Make sure you time your attacks carefully to eliminate it.

skills.name: Rumble
skills.description: Lock on to a target and fire a round of high-energy ammunition, dealing massive damage and AoE damage.

skills.name: Sacred Garden
skills.description: Greatly reduce damage received and keep regenerating shield.

205001.introduce: Similar to the Gunner, but with improved firepower. The harder-hitting weapon comes at the cost of reduced mobility.
205001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

206001.introduce: An elite Paradeus unit who looks like a frail and delicate girl, but once she dons her custom-made mask and mounts her personal mech, you will wish you could run faster.
206001.counter: This unit has the ability to cause severe disruption on the battlefield. Make sure you engage with a suitable echelon.

207001.introduce: An assassin of unknown origin affiliated with Paradeus. He is a bizarre patchwork of man and machine. The technology employed in his creation seems to be different from what can be found on other Paradeus units.
207001.counter: This unit deals very powerful slash damage. Make sure you engage with a suitable echelon.

skills.name: Annihilation
skills.description: Greatly increase attack speed and keep attacking the target until they are out of range.

skills.name: Likeness Repels
skills.description: Select a random target, then launch framentary grenades at the positions of the target and all units of the same type, dealing damage and giving them a Weakened marker.

skills.name: Kizlyar Knife
skills.description: Perform a melee attack on the target with the highest number of markers, dealing multiple instances of large damage.

skills.name: Breakdown
skills.description: Damage intake is greatly increased while becoming immobilized. Afterwards, go berserk (damage, rate of fire, accuracy, durability, resistance are all greatly increased).

208001.introduce: A Dummy of M4A1, but without her indecisiveness. It obeys without question.

209001.introduce: A Dummy of ST AR-15. Other than the missing sneer, it looks no different from the mainframe.

210001.introduce: A Dummy of M4 SOPMOD II. Its operation logic is completely identical to the mainframe. It even has the same terrifying laugh.

211001.introduce: M16A1, who has been given a special mission and authorizations, must wake up at each important fork and push the AR Team back onto their path towards the light.

212001.introduce: An armed member of the Beslan Guards Regiment, a group that is comprised of fanatical extremists with formal tactical training and skills in using firearms. They are one of the main armed forces taking part in the riot.
212001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

213001.introduce: A heavy-firepower droid that wields a machine gun. When the machine gun is charged, it can fire three plasma beams, which can blind enemies and ignore their evasion to a certain extent. Its destructiveness is further increased when equipped with [Flask of Aceso], but it deals significantly less damage when in a weakened state.
213001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

skills.name: Hand-held Laser Beam
skills.description: Fire a beam at a random enemy. Enemies it touches take guaranteed damage and are blinded, which reduces accuracy. Needs to Recharge once every 3 attacks. While Recharging, self evasion is decreased.

216001.introduce: Dreamer - Moonlit Sentinel is a specialized model developed for fighting in the dark. Her optimized laser weapon can penetrate to back-row enemies from a longer distance. The devil's horns custom-made to Dreamer's own specifications also emit a jamming signal while in battle, enshrouding herself and her allies in layers of thick, black smoke, turning them into phantoms that spread confusion, chaos, and imminent death... You'd better pray you never encounter her during the night... because no prey survives in an environment where she has the absolute upper hand.
216001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

225001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

skills.name: Energy Strike
skills.description: Launch a ball of energy at the target with the highest HP, dealing damage that scales with self Dummy-Links.

233001.introduce: A pixelated entity of unknown origin. It is vicious, unpredictable, and possesses all sorts of powers from this strange world. All in all, a strong and dangerous one.

skills.name: Pentacles
skills.description: Starting with 3 Pentacles, gain 1 Pentacle every 3 seconds, capping at 6 Pentacles.

skills.name: Swords
skills.description: Consume 2 Pentacles to summon a Sword above 3 random enemies, dealing 999 points of damage in a small area. Each successful hit generates 2 Pentacles.

skills.name: Cups
skills.description: Take no more than 999 points of damage for each hit. When HP falls below 50%, consume 1 Pentacle to gain a shield. Gain additional shield HP for every Pentacle in possession.

skills.name: Wands
skills.description: Consume 2 Pentacles to summon 2 clones, and increase the entire echelon's damage and evasion. After 10 seconds, the clones self-destruct, dealing AoE damage that scales with Dummy-Links and generating 1 Pentacle.

skills.name: Draw I
skills.description:
When HP falls below 80%, trigger one of the following effects at random:
The Emperor: Reduce movement speed, rate of fire, and accuracy for both sides.
The Hierophant: Both sides summon front-row units to aid in battle.
The Chariot: Both sides conduct artillery strikes.

skills.name: Draw II
skills.description:
When HP falls below 60%, trigger one of the following effects at random:
The Lovers: Units on neither side will lose Dummy-Links or die.
The Hermit: Accuracy is significantly reduced for both sides.
Temperance: Remove debuffs on both sides.

skills.name: Draw III
skills.description:
When HP falls below 30%, trigger one of the following effects at random:
Death: Both sides take a massive amount of damage.
The Devil: Both sides take corrosive damage.
The Moon: Both sides regain their lost shields.

234001.introduce: After abandoning Sangvis Ferri, Elisa has become crueler, more ruthless, and even closer to a perfect AI. When there is nothing to lose, there is nothing to fear.
234001.counter: The Reverse Collapse effect might render your Dolls unable to fight, but floating in the air is also a form of protection. Make use of this to evade otherwise unavoidable damage!

skills.name: Charge Attack
skills.description: Launch a charged attack after every 6 normal attacks, dealing damage to all enemy units.

skills.name: Reverse Collapse
skills.description: Cause the unit furthest from herself to float into the air at regular intervals. Floating units are not affected by surface damage. At the same time, uncontrolled Reverse Collapse zones appear on the battlefield as the battle progresses.

skills.name: Glow of Termination
skills.description: Deal high damage to all units, while also creating a 3-tile radius Reverse Collapse zone.

235001.introduce: With the support of Paradeus' technology, RPK-16's modification is now partially complete. Although is still in an incomplete state, her firepower has been greatly enhanced and she can use certain Paradeus core technologies. Their effect on her neural cloud remains unknown.
235001.counter: This unit can command multiple Paradeus combat units. Engage with caution!

skills.name: Command Mission
skills.description: Embla will periodically summon Paradeus units into battle.

skills.name: Collapse
skills.description: Random tiles will be attacked by falling ceiling debris. Units hit will be damaged and stunned.

skills.name: Bugle Call
skills.description: Embla will provide a shield to units in front of her and increase damage for units behind her.

skills.name: Evolve
skills.description:
Embla will switch between recovery mode and assault mode:
Recovery Mode: Restore shields of other enemy units every 3 seconds.
Assault Mode: Increase ROF and movement speed of other enemy units every 3 seconds.

skills.name: Obsession
skills.description: Embla will receive a high-powered shield and taunt all friendly units to attack her. If the shield is broken after some time, all enemy units will be paralyzed and receive massively increased damage. Otherwise, all enemy units will receive high HP shields and a huge increase to damage.

236001.introduce: Gager - Seaside Combat Specialist type, or VWV for short, is a specialized frame modified and optimized for naval combat based on Gager's original frame. If Gager is not near the sea, she will modify the surrounding environment to that of a seaside-like environment using stored material before commencing combat. The anchor-like weapon allows her to dole out brutal firepower while also providing the ability to summon wind waves.
236001.counter: Now having switched to a naval combat frame, Gager boasts stronger combat engineering abilities and an improvement to firepower and command ability.

237001.introduce: The Military's regular combat mech. Upgraded and modified from the "Nemeum", it is outfitted with a military-grade long-range firing system, giving it even stronger armor and higher rapid-fire capabilities.
237001.counter: There is little pause between attacks from this armored unit, which deals significant damage. It is recommended to prioritize killing them with Rifle T-Dolls.

238001.introduce: A regular military mech modified to the German army's requirements. Equipped with upgraded armor and a military-use long-range fire control system, the fearsome main cannons are effective in sweeping enemy positions with devastating firepower.
238001.counter: Best to avoid this if your echelon is not in good condition.

skills.name: Strafe
skills.description: After every third attack, the Andvari performs a sweeping attack which does great damage to all enemy units within a certain radius.

239001.introduce: The German army's locally-produced specialist mech. With the ability to effectively disrupt the enemy whilst protecting itself, the Loki is often used as an ace in the hole for tactical suppression.
239001.counter: This unit possesses a certain degree of armor, so make sure your echelon has enough armor piercing and try to maximize your defenses in the front row. In addition, take care to move units targeted by its powerful cannon shot to prevent your backliners from taking damage.

skills.name: Smoke Tactics
skills.description: Randomly fire smoke grenades into enemy territory, reducing enemy units' move speed and accuracy by 30% for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Deep Strike
skills.description: Lock onto a unit in the front row, then fire a round after 2 seconds of aiming, dealing damage to all Dummy-Links of the target and dealing somewhat less damage to all Dummy-Links of the units behind the target.

240001.introduce: The German army's regular combat Doll, equipped with an assault rifle and a grenade launcher with relatively high firepower. Its armor is weaker compared to other similar models.
240001.counter: This enemy is well-balanced so be sure to fight her with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

241001.introduce: The German army's regular combat Doll, equipped with a shotgun and ballistic shield.
241001.counter: This unit is well-balanced and has significant armor. Engage with an echelon that has adequate overall combat effectiveness.

242001.introduce: The German army's regular combat Doll, equipped with a rifle. It boasts ample long-range firepower.
242001.counter: This unit is responsible for doling out firepower from the backline. To take them out, the utilization of Dolls who prioritize targeting the backline is recommended.

100083001.introduce: A Nemeum which has been greatly enhanced over its original specs, able to better display its combat abilities.
100083001.counter: This armored unit is mainly a damage dealer on the back row. It has a low rate of fire but high accuracy, dealing steady and significant damage to the player's units in the front row. It is recommended to clear them up with Dolls who prioritize targets in the back row.
